Chapter 1249 - 9: The Great Saint Of The Galaxy, Come Forth Quickly (Request For Monthly Ticket At The Beginning Of The Month)_2

Chapter 1249: Chapter 9: The Great Saint of the Galaxy, Come Forth Quickly (Request for Monthly Ticket at the Beginning of the Month)_2

"Almost certainly crossing into the thirteenth stage..."

Lin Yuan pondered over many things. At the very least, this indicated that the path he was currently on was not problematic. Moreover, the contingencies he had set up, like spreading the branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road, were indeed the right approach.

...

"Galaxy, if there’s anything else you need, just say it," stated the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness.

At this moment, since Lin Yuan had not yet crossed into the thirteenth stage, any request he made could be met by these ancestors.

And once Lin Yuan voiced a request, and they managed to fulfill it, it signified a deeper bond of fate and friendship between the two sides.

This was practically a free opportunity. If they waited until Lin Yuan also stepped into the thirteenth stage and then made his demands, these ancestors might not be able to assist.

It’s not that they were unwilling to help, but that it would be beyond their capabilities.

"Yes, Galaxy, just speak directly," the Xuanyin Ancestor echoed.

"I wish to comprehend more of the supreme inheritances and guidance," Lin Yuan said, looking at the five ancestors.

"More supreme inheritances and guidance?" The Da Fu Ancestor and the other four ancestors immediately understood.

The treasuries of the major ancient countries contained many supreme inheritances and guidance. To obtain these, one must make contributions to the ancient country, and even if one practiced and comprehended them, they were prohibited from being shared. This had to be sworn in the name of an ancestor.

If violated, it would provoke an ancestor to act.

Therefore,

for Lin Yuan to seek comprehension of the supreme inheritances and guidance of the other five major ancient countries, he needed the agreement of the five ancestors.

"This is nothing." With a wave of his large hand, the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness produced a jade slip before him, which recorded all the supreme inheritances and guidance of the Barbaric Wilderness Country.

Supreme inheritances and guidance, while important because they cannot be shared, had few avenues of acquisition, being essentially monopolized by the major ancient countries.

But in terms of their importance, they weren’t so crucial. After all, as long as it was an inheritance guide, it could be replicated; aside from the initial creation, there were nearly no subsequent costs.

The other four ancestors also respectively brought forth their own ancient country’s supreme inheritance guides, even going so far as to annotate some content with their insights.

"Thank you."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. He had long been interested in the supreme inheritances of the major ancient countries.

When he first took charge of the Hei Yu Nest, leaving behind the Xuanyin Ancestor’s two Heavenly Venerates, he noticed signs of having practiced the supreme inheritance "Xuanyin Secret Scripture" from them and wanted to take a look.

"There’s one more thing." Lin Yuan put away the numerous guides and looked towards the ancestors.

"Galaxy, speak quickly," the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness immediately said.

The more requests Lin Yuan made, the happier he was.

"The Martial Tao cultivation inheritance I’ve established, I intend to spread across the six major ancient countries..." Lin Yuan stated.

Spreading the branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road was something Lin Yuan had continuously pursued, and even after hearing from the ancestors that he was almost certain to cross into the thirteenth stage, Lin Yuan wouldn’t give up.

Who knew if that "almost certain" success was due to the merits of the Martial Arts Evolution Road branches?

Furthermore, the timelines seen by the ancestors were limited, and the so-called "almost certain" still contained variables, so naturally, he would strive to make everything as perfect as possible.

"Spreading the Martial Tao cultivation inheritance? No problem."

"I’ll give the order immediately."

The Da Fu Ancestor and the other four ancestors nodded. By observing future timelines, they knew that the Martial Tao cultivation inheritance was a transmission not in the least inferior to the terrifying inheritances cultivated by the major ancestors.

In many future timelines, the Galaxy Venerate was essentially spreading the Martial Tao cultivation inheritance.

...

The Da Fu Ancestor, Da Ling Ancestor, and the other five ancestors continued to chat with Lin Yuan for a while. After confirming that the Galaxy Venerate had no other needs, they rose to take their leave.

Once the five ancestors returned to their respective ancient countries, a series of orders related to the Galaxy Venerate began to be fully implemented.

The most important point was that the Galaxy Venerate must not be provoked, especially by those at the Heavenly Venerate level in the major ancient countries.

Next was the promotion of the Martial Tao cultivation inheritance established by the Galaxy Venerate across the major ancient countries.

This left countless powerful figures in the six major ancient countries somewhat bewildered.

"We must not offend the Galaxy Venerate? Orders from the ancestors themselves?"

"Why would the exalted ancestors care about the Galaxy Venerate?"

"And the Martial Tao cultivation inheritance? It makes sense for the Fierce Sun Ancient Country to spread it, since the Galaxy Venerate is from there, but the other five major ancient countries?"

"I can sense that the orders from the ancestors are due to the Galaxy Venerate being too extraordinary."

"For all five ancestors to treat the Galaxy Venerate in this manner, what capabilities does the Galaxy Venerate possess?"

The powerful figures of the six major ancient countries were full of incredulity. The strange attitude of the ancestors left many unable to comprehend. Although the power of the Galaxy Venerate was indeed formidable, being the first Invincible Venerable,

however strong he might be, could he be stronger than the ancestors?

Nevertheless, even though they didn’t understand, since the ancestors did not wish to provoke the Galaxy Venerate, these Great Lords and Heavenly Venerates, even with all their courage, wouldn’t dare to anger the Galaxy Venerate.

In fact, even without the ancestors’ orders, no Great Lord would provoke the Galaxy Venerate. The title of Invincible Venerable was not given lightly; even the strongest Venerable of the Da Fu Ancient Kingdom, when faced with the Galaxy Venerate, could only despairingly attempt to cultivate a forbidden supreme inheritance to oppose him.

...

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with a heart in front of him pulsating like an abyss.

It was the Abyss Dragon’s Heart.

As the first existence born in this Fang Yuan World, even if the Abyss Dragon hadn’t crossed into the thirteenth stage, its uniqueness wasn’t much weaker than that of time beings.

After crossing into the thirteenth stage, the Da Fu Ancestor’s first action was to suppress and kill it, not only due to their enmity but also because the Abyss Dragon was indeed too unique.

If it weren’t for wanting to foster goodwill with Lin Yuan, the Da Fu Ancestor would never have taken out this Abyss Dragon’s Heart.

"Too perfect..."

Lin Yuan stared intently at the miniature source world within the heart, showing signs of fascination.

By observing the source world within the heart, Lin Yuan vaguely understood why this source world was called the source world, and why the Chaos Void, a presence no less than the source world, was not among the thirty-three source worlds?

"The most fundamental aspect of a source world is ’perfection.’"

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

The boundless, borderless Chaos Void had many flaws and hidden dangers.

The special places established by thirteenth stage time beings were meant to cover up and compensate for these corresponding dangers.

But this source world had none; at least, through the miniature source world within the Abyss Dragon’s Heart, Lin Yuan had not discovered any flaws or deficiencies.

The overall impression the source world left on Lin Yuan was one of perfection.

Even though there would still be a day of the great catastrophe, its existence time far exceeded that of the Chaos Void.

...

Chaos Void.

Outside the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Two figures appeared out of thin air; the one on the left was a bald man, and the one on the right appeared rather lean.

The aura emitted by the two figures was extremely terrifying, causing the rules of the Great Dao operating in the Chaos Void to retreat continuously; they were undoubtedly two peerless Great Saints.

"During this period, we reviewed every enemy with slight causal ties to the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix Great Saints and found nothing particular, only this Galaxy Great Saint remains."

The lean figure on the right spoke softly. The two peerless Great Saints had been ordered by the Luo Hou Great Saint to investigate the cause behind the complete disappearance of the causal ties of the Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

The origin of the Galaxy Great Saint was mysterious, yet within the Xuanhuang Universe, he alone had slain the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix, leading the two peerless Great Saints to deduce that there must have been some unknown enmity between them.

"Quickly confirm it, and then return to report."

The bald figure said, not believing that the complete disappearance of the causal ties of the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix had anything to do with the Galaxy Great Saint. Regardless of his strength, based on his performance within the Xuanhuang Universe, he wasn’t a peerless Great Saint.

To silently and effortlessly erase the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix Great Saints? It was near impossible.

The aim of the two peerless Great Saints’ visit was just to complete their task; at the very least, they could report to the Luo Hou Great Saint that they had put in their best effort and reviewed the numerous foes of the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix.

"Okay."

The lean figure on the right nodded, then stepped forward, looking down over the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

"Galaxy Great Saint, aren’t you coming out quickly to meet us!"

The terrifying sound wave penetrated layers of time and space, instantly reaching every corner of the Galaxy Chaos Continent.
